Thrivers & Survivors Charity Golf Tournament

Support Cancer Patients. Expand Access. Make a Difference. We are thrilled to announce our upcoming charity golf event benefiting thesecondopinion, taking place at the iconic TPC Harding Park on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. In recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month, this year’s event will specifically honor and support breast cancer patients. This meaningful day will bring together 100 participants—including golfers, cancer patients, physicians, and community members—all united in support of adults across California facing a cancer diagnosis.
About the Event & Opportunity:
We invite you to join us as a sponsor, donor or player. Your support will directly benefit cancer patients, especially those in underserved and rural communities, by helping us continue to provide free, comprehensive second opinions.
Whether you're an individual golfer, foursome, sponsor, or volunteer, your participation helps ensure that no one has to face a cancer diagnosis alone. Your registration includes:
-18 holes of championship golf
-Lunch and post golf BBQ
-Contests, prizes and auction
-Awards reception
-The opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of cancer patients
Register today and help us drive hope forward!

We are also grateful for donated items for raffle or prize giveaways. Every contribution helps us reach more patients and bring hope where it’s needed most.
Why Your Support Matters:
Since 1969, thesecondopinion has provided free second opinions to adults diagnosed with cancer across California. We focus on serving those who face language, cultural, and financial barriers to care. Our service empowers patients with education, clarity, and confidence to make informed medical decisions—transforming fear into hope.
By sponsoring this event (sponsor button is below the registration button) you're not just supporting a day on the golf course—you're helping people navigate the most difficult journey of their lives with dignity, knowledge, and support.
Join Us
Make a meaningful impact. Stand with cancer patients and their families. Help us extend our reach and deepen our support.
